# `aitbc wallet backup`

Export a wallet to a password-encrypted backup file at the given path.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet backup [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Wallet name. |
| `--destination` | text | — | no | Destination path for backup file |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet backup --name <name>
```
